mapper.insert: insert into clazz (name, room, begin_date, end_date, master_id, subject,create_time, update_time,status) values (#{name}, #{room}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{masterId}, #{subject},#{createTime},#{updateTime},#{status});
mapper.update: update clazz set name = #{name},room = #{room},begin_date = #{beginDate},end_date = #{endDate},master_id = #{masterId},subject = #{subject},create_time = #{createTime},update_time = #{updateTime},status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select c.id, c.name, c.room, c.begin_date, c.end_date, c.master_id, c.subject, c.create_time, c.update_time from clazz c left join emp e on c.master_id = e.id where c.id = #{id}

select c.id, c.name, c.room, c.begin_date, c.end_date, c.master_id, e.name as master_name, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.status from clazz c left join emp e on c.master_id = e.id order by c.update_time desc
